claims.claim: Last Mile is an independent physical operations platform designed to connect operating conditions, coordinated work, and verified physical outcomes.
The platform model comprises Infinit-Signal, Singularity, Infinit-Flow, and Infinit-Control.
Operational records are created once as canonical records and consumed through governed product contracts.
Consequential physical actions remain governed by customer policy and human authority.
Recovery is evaluated from return telemetry and operating evidence rather than ticket closure alone.
